title: Suspected post-operative endophthalmitis
logic: Intraocular surgery within the past 6 weeks AND (increasing eye pain OR worsening vision OR hypopyon OR marked anterior chamber inflammation OR lid swelling with red eye)
action: Same-day emergency referral to the operating eye unit; do NOT start topical antibiotics alone and observe — the patient needs urgent intraocular sampling and intravitreal antibiotics at referral level; vision is lost in hours to days

title: Acute angle-closure attack recognition
logic: Painful red eye AND reduced vision AND fixed mid-dilated pupil, with headache/nausea, especially in an older patient in low light
action: Emergency: start available pressure-lowering therapy immediately and refer the same day for iridotomy/iridectomy; record IOP if tonometry available; flag the FELLOW eye for prophylactic treatment at the same referral

title: Leukocoria in a child
logic: White pupillary reflex, new squint with poor vision, or absent red reflex in a child under 6 years, noted at any encounter including immunisation visits
action: Urgent referral to the national eye referral centre within one week — retinoblastoma until proven otherwise; do not schedule routine review; document red reflex findings for both eyes

title: WHO cataract surgical outcome banding
logic: Post-cataract refraction visit at 4-8 weeks with best-corrected acuity recorded
action: Auto-band the outcome: good (6/6-6/18), borderline (worse than 6/18 to 6/60), poor (worse than 6/60); poor outcomes trigger case review for cause (surgical complication, comorbid pathology, refractive error) and feed the unit outcome register

title: Biometry or IOL-policy check before cataract listing
logic: Cataract surgery with IOL booked AND no biometry result recorded AND no explicit standard-power-IOL policy justification captured
action: Prompt for A-scan/keratometry results or a documented reason for using the unit standard-power lens (outreach without biometry); record which applies on the operative plan

title: Pre-operative acuity recorded for every eye procedure
logic: Any ophthalmic operation booked or performed AND presenting visual acuity of BOTH eyes is absent from the record
action: Block operative-record completion until acuity of both eyes is captured (including NPL/PL/HM/CF gradings); for trauma this is the key prognostic and medicolegal baseline

title: Povidone-iodine antisepsis before intraocular surgery
logic: Intraocular procedure operative record completed without conjunctival povidone-iodine preparation documented
action: Prompt to document povidone-iodine instillation into the conjunctival sac before draping — the strongest-evidence endophthalmitis prevention step; record allergy-driven substitution where applicable

title: Open globe systemic cover and tetanus
logic: Open globe injury recorded AND (no systemic antibiotic recorded OR tetanus prophylaxis status missing)
action: Prompt to start systemic antibiotic prophylaxis per protocol and confirm tetanus status before transfer/theatre; add rigid eye shield and nil-by-mouth to the pre-transfer checklist

title: Day-1 review after intraocular surgery
logic: MSICS/phaco/trabeculectomy performed AND no next-day review encounter scheduled
action: Auto-book day-1 review (acuity, wound/bleb, anterior chamber, IOP) and week-1-2 review; for outreach cases assign the review to the nearest facility with the findings checklist attached

title: Post-cataract refraction and spectacle provision
logic: Cataract surgery performed AND no refraction visit recorded by 8 weeks
action: Generate recall for refraction at 4-6 weeks with spectacle dispensing pathway; unrefracted patients under-realise the acuity gain and skew outcome statistics
